name: Böblingen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Böblingen (a red three-tailed banner on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Böblingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Böblingen arms — red banner on yellow
